info.name: Under the Bridge
info.plot: Adattamento dell’omonimo libro di Rebecca Godfrey, il thriller drammatico racconta la vera storia dell’omicidio di Reena Virk, quattordicenne canadese brutalmente assassinata per futili motivi da un gruppetto di coetanee.

translations.value: Adattamento dell’omonimo libro di Rebecca Godfrey, il thriller drammatico racconta la vera storia dell’omicidio di Reena Virk, quattordicenne canadese brutalmente assassinata per futili motivi da un gruppetto di coetanee.

episodes.name: Looking Glass
episodes.plot: In 1997, on a quiet island in BC, fourteen-year-old Reena Virk attends a party and never returns home. Her disappearance intrigues a novelist returning to her hometown, who finds herself drawn into the hidden world of the teen suspects…

translations.value: In 1997, on a quiet island in BC, fourteen-year-old Reena Virk attends a party and never returns home. Her disappearance intrigues a novelist returning to her hometown, who finds herself drawn into the hidden world of the teen suspects…

episodes.name: The John Gotti of Seven Oaks
episodes.plot: Cam is thrown by a shocking discovery, and the police rush to unravel what really happened under the bridge. Josephine makes a deal with Rebecca, while a look into the past reveals Reena's first rebellion.

episodes.name: Blood Oath
episodes.plot: Upsetting news shakes the small town of Victoria, and as rumors surface, Rebecca and Cam reconnect. In the past, Reena enters Josephine's mafia fantasy world.

episodes.name: Beautiful British Columbia
episodes.plot: In 1979, Suman and Manjit fall in love, setting into motion a series of events that will change their lives forever. In 1997, the Seven Oaks girls come to the Virk house for a dinner to remember, leading to the shocking revelation of Manjit's secret.

translations.value: In 1979, Suman and Manjit fall in love, setting into motion a series of events that will change their lives forever. In 1997, the Seven Oaks girls come to the Virk house for a dinner to remember, leading to the shocking revelation of Manjit's secret.

episodes.name: When the Heat Comes Down
episodes.plot: Tensions rise as suspicions surround the teens. Rebecca and Cam hatch a plan — but an unexpected detour leads Rebecca down a strange rabbit hole, resulting in a new bond.

translations.value: Tensions rise as suspicions surround the teens. Rebecca and Cam hatch a plan — but an unexpected detour leads Rebecca down a strange rabbit hole, resulting in a new bond.

episodes.name: In acqua affondano allo stesso modo
episodes.plot: Ferite passate e presenti si intrecciano mentre l'alleanza tra Rebecca e Cam viene messa alla prova. I Virk non sanno se prendere in mano la situazione e le adolescenti usano un ballo della scuola come copertura per il loro piano di fuga, tutto questo mentre un'altra vita è minacciata.

episodes.name: Tre e sette
episodes.plot: Lo svolgimento del processo spinge Rebecca al limite e comincia a domandarsi chi dovrebbe difendere. La fedeltà di Cam al sistema giudiziario viene messa alla prova quando vengono finalmente rivelati i dettagli della notte dell'omicidio.

episodes.name: Solo misericordia
episodes.plot: Arriva l'ultima opportunità per ottenere giustizia e tutti i partecipanti fanno i conti con il loro reale coinvolgimento negli eventi accaduti. Una scelta radicale di perdono concede una conclusione.
